## PR Title

Before opening or updating this PR, make sure the title follows Conventional Commits:

```text
<type>(optional-scope): <short description>
```

Allowed types: `feat`, `fix`, `perf`, `revert`, `refactor`, `docs`, `test`, `build`, `ci`, `chore`, `deps`.

Examples:

- `feat(console): show store-all node status`
- `fix(storage): respect archive disk headroom`
- `docs: clarify release workflow`

Sentence-style titles like `Show store-all node status in console` fail CI.
